dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「すっかり、春になってきましたねえ」
dialogues.en: "Spring is really in full flow now."
dialogues.text: "Spring is really in full flow now."

dialogues.jp: 空を見上げ、音夢が目を細める。
dialogues.en: Nemu squinted her eyes as she looked up to the sky.
dialogues.text: Nemu squinted her eyes as she looked up to the sky.

dialogues.jp:
「……そうか？　いつもと変わらん風景だろう
　が。桜とか」
dialogues.en:
"...Really? It's not like these falling sakura petals ever
change."
dialogues.text:
"...Really? It's not like these falling sakura petals ever
change."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「逆に言えば、桜だけって事ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Spring isn't just about the sakura, you know."
dialogues.text: "Spring isn't just about the sakura, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だんだんと空気の肌触りが変わってきました
　し、ちらほら虫も居ます」
dialogues.en:
"You can feel a change in the air, there are more insects
around..."
dialogues.text:
"You can feel a change in the air, there are more insects
around..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「商店街では、春らしいバーゲンセールがやっ
　てるんですよ。入学祝いの贈答品とか」
dialogues.en:
"Not to mention the shopping district always holds bargain
sales around springtime, to coincide with all the opening of
schools."
dialogues.text:
"Not to mention the shopping district always holds bargain
sales around springtime, to coincide with all the opening of
schools."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「良く見てるんだな」
dialogues.en: "You've seen that a lot, I bet."
dialogues.text: "You've seen that a lot, I bet."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんが、見てないだけですよ」
dialogues.en: "While the opposite holds true for you."
dialogues.text: "While the opposite holds true for you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それでですね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "By the way, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "By the way, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.jp:
改めて、という様子で、こちらに顔を向けてく
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked towards me with a blank face.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked towards me with a blank face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何で、この道を歩いているんです？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you walking this way?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you walking this way?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あいたたた！　な、何するんですかっ」
dialogues.en: "Owowowow! What are you doing!"
dialogues.text: "Owowowow! What are you doing!"

dialogues.jp:
頭をわしゃっと鷲掴みにして、足下に目を向け
させる。
dialogues.en:
I grab at her head, looking down on her as menacingly as I
can.
dialogues.text:
I grab at her head, looking down on her as menacingly as I
can.

dialogues.jp: 「良く見ているお前の事だ。言葉はいらんだろ」
dialogues.en: "It's none of your business, stop talking about it."
dialogues.text: "It's none of your business, stop talking about it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「い、いるっ。いる〜！」
dialogues.en: "It is, it is~~"
dialogues.text: "It is, it is~~"

dialogues.jp: 仕方なく、頭を解放してやる。
dialogues.en: I finally let go of her head.
dialogues.text: I finally let go of her head.

dialogues.jp:
水中でビート板を離したように、ぴょこんと音
夢が浮かび上がった。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I let go of her twin underwater beetles, she
stood up straight again.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I let go of her twin underwater beetles, she
stood up straight again.

dialogues.jp: 「足だろ？」
dialogues.en: "Is something wrong with your foot?"
dialogues.text: "Is something wrong with your foot?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 髪型を整えながら、音夢が目をぱちくりさせた。
dialogues.en: Straightening her hair, Nemu looked up at me questioningly.
dialogues.text: Straightening her hair, Nemu looked up at me questioningly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "Why would there be?"
dialogues.text: "Why would there be?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、何でって」
dialogues.en: "Because of what you asked?"
dialogues.text: "Because of what you asked?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、わざとやってます？」
dialogues.en: "Brother, are you doing this on purpose?"
dialogues.text: "Brother, are you doing this on purpose?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん」
dialogues.en: "More or less."
dialogues.text: "More or less."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「理由の方に決まってるじゃないですか。り、
　ゆ、う」
dialogues.en: "I mean, what's your reason for doing this. R-E-A-S-O-N."
dialogues.text: "I mean, what's your reason for doing this. R-E-A-S-O-N."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はあ？　学生が学園に行くの、当たり前だろ？
　お前、大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en:
"Hah? All the students go to school this way. Are you
feeling okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Hah? All the students go to school this way. Are you
feeling okay?"

dialogues.jp:
思わず額に額を持っていこうとするが、人の目
をはっと意識する。
dialogues.en:
I unconciously started moving my forehead towards her's, but
the people around me managed to bring me back to my senses.
dialogues.text:
I unconciously started moving my forehead towards her's, but
the people around me managed to bring me back to my senses.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……わざと言ってます？」
dialogues.en: "...Do you really mean that?"
dialogues.text: "...Do you really mean that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……本気なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Haah... guess you're serious."
dialogues.text: "Haah... guess you're serious."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さっきから何か変だぞ？　春だからって、油
　断しすぎじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"You're being rather weird today. Are you feeling okay? Is
spring doing weird things?"
dialogues.text:
"You're being rather weird today. Are you feeling okay? Is
spring doing weird things?"

dialogues.jp: だんだんと音夢のことが心配になってくる。
dialogues.en: That girl always makes me worry.
dialogues.text: That girl always makes me worry.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その言葉、そっくり兄さんにお返しします」
dialogues.en: "I could say the same for you."
dialogues.text: "I could say the same for you."

dialogues.jp:
澄ました顔で音夢が言う。そして、にこりと微
笑んだ。
dialogues.en: Nemu simply stated, a little smile on her face.
dialogues.text: Nemu simply stated, a little smile on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、忘れちゃったのね」
dialogues.en: "You forgot about today, apparently."
dialogues.text: "You forgot about today, apparently."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何を？」
dialogues.en: "What about?"
dialogues.text: "What about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「今日から、卒業パーティーの準備期間だって
　事を」
dialogues.en:
"That from today onwards, school only consists of graduation
party preparations."
dialogues.text:
"That from today onwards, school only consists of graduation
party preparations."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ、兄さんの事だもの。かったるいとか
　言って、なぁんにも参加しないんでしょ」
dialogues.en:
"And that's none of your concern, since you shrugged off any
attempts to get you to participate with your famous
"troublesome"."
dialogues.text:
"And that's none of your concern, since you shrugged off any
attempts to get you to participate with your famous
"troublesome"."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ってことは、兄さんは、事実上春休みに入っ
　てるって事なんですよ。お分かり？」
dialogues.en:
"So the truth is that you have nothing to do during the
spring break, which is why you came. Right?"
dialogues.text:
"So the truth is that you have nothing to do during the
spring break, which is why you came. Right?"

dialogues.jp:
憎たらしい微笑みに、思わずほっぺたをひねくっ
てやりたくなる。
dialogues.en: Nemu grinned evilly, her cheeks puffing out involuntarily.
dialogues.text: Nemu grinned evilly, her cheeks puffing out involuntarily.

dialogues.jp:
うりゃっ、このっ、何だよ、意外にすべすべじゃ
ねーか。
dialogues.en: Damnit, why are her cheeks so damn smooth.
dialogues.text: Damnit, why are her cheeks so damn smooth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……兄さん、何やってるの？　ほっぺたなん
　か引っ張って」
dialogues.en: "...Nii-san, what's wrong? Why are you pulling your cheeks?"
dialogues.text: "...Nii-san, what's wrong? Why are you pulling your cheeks?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前の代わりだ」
dialogues.en: "It's all your fault."
dialogues.text: "It's all your fault."

dialogues.jp: ほへほへと、不明瞭な言葉を呟く。
dialogues.en: I muttered, barely intelligibly.
dialogues.text: I muttered, barely intelligibly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?!"
dialogues.text: "Huh?!"

dialogues.jp:
首を傾げる音夢を尻目に、俺はため息混じりに
呟いた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu tilted her neck in thought, and I sighed and murmured
at the same time.
dialogues.text:
Nemu tilted her neck in thought, and I sighed and murmured
at the same time.

dialogues.jp: 「かったるい……」
dialogues.en: "How troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "How troublesome..."

dialogues.jp: 「朝倉く〜ん！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kuuun!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kuuun!"

dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp: 背後からの声に振り向く。
dialogues.en: I turn around to face the voice from behind me.
dialogues.text: I turn around to face the voice from behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、朝倉君。妹さんの、音夢さん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-kun! And you too, Nemu-san."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-kun! And you too, Nemu-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、あっ……おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Eh, Ah.... good morning."
dialogues.text: "Eh, Ah.... good morning."

dialogues.jp:
一瞬の混乱を、裏モード全開の丁寧なお辞儀で
やり過ごす。さすがは音夢。
dialogues.en:
After just a slight moment of confusion, her transformation
into reverse mode was complete. She gave Kotori a respectul
bow.
dialogues.text:
After just a slight moment of confusion, her transformation
into reverse mode was complete. She gave Kotori a respectul
bow.

dialogues.jp:
「……って、ことりって、音夢の事知ってたっ
　け？」
dialogues.en: "...Huh, Kotori, you know about Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "...Huh, Kotori, you know about Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "(...He just calls her Kotori so freely?)"
dialogues.text: "(...He just calls her Kotori so freely?)"

dialogues.jp:
頭の触角が異様な反応を示した気がするが、こ
の際気にしない。
dialogues.en:
The feelers on her head immediately stood at attention, to
my unawareness.
dialogues.text:
The feelers on her head immediately stood at attention, to
my unawareness.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、お互い中央委員会と風紀委員で、顔を
　合わせる機会がありますから……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, the student committee is pretty closely linked to the
disciplinary committee, so we've exchanged greetings..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, the student committee is pretty closely linked to the
disciplinary committee, so we've exchanged greetings..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ですね」
dialogues.en: "Yup."
dialogues.text: "Yup."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「なるほど。ま、突っ立っていてもアレだし、
　さっさと学園に向かおうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"I see. Anyway, let's head to school instead of just
standing around like this."
dialogues.text:
"I see. Anyway, let's head to school instead of just
standing around like this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, let's."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, let's."

dialogues.jp: 止まっていた足を動かす。
dialogues.en: Our previously stalled legs finally began to move.
dialogues.text: Our previously stalled legs finally began to move.

dialogues.jp:
その時になって、周りの視線を集めていたらし
い事に気が付いた。
dialogues.en:
But there was something particularly different than before;
something about our surroundings.
dialogues.text:
But there was something particularly different than before;
something about our surroundings.

dialogues.jp:
俺らが前を向いた途端に、弾かれたように散っ
ていった目玉が何組か。
dialogues.en:
I could distinctly feel as if I was being watched by several
people as I walked.
dialogues.text:
I could distinctly feel as if I was being watched by several
people as I walked.

dialogues.jp: （ことり、か）
dialogues.en: "(Or rather, watching Kotori...)"
dialogues.text: "(Or rather, watching Kotori...)"

dialogues.jp:
人気者はツライって事か。やれやれと、内心で
肩をすくめた。
dialogues.en:
The pain of popularity. It must be hard having a chip on
your shoulder like that.
dialogues.text:
The pain of popularity. It must be hard having a chip on
your shoulder like that.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、そのマスクどうしたの？　風邪？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, what's up with the mask? Do you still have a
cold?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, what's up with the mask? Do you still have a
cold?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと悪化しちゃったんです。……それに、
　人に移したら悪いですからね」
dialogues.en:
"It sort of got worse... I wanted to make sure I didn't
infect anyone else."
dialogues.text:
"It sort of got worse... I wanted to make sure I didn't
infect anyone else."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの風邪なら移されたいって男子学生が、
居るような気がする。あいつとか、そいつとか。
dialogues.en:
...Although there's several male students who would faint at
the thought of possessing something of Kotori's, even a
germ.
dialogues.text:
...Although there's several male students who would faint at
the thought of possessing something of Kotori's, even a
germ.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……風邪を引くのは、誰だって嫌ですからね」
dialogues.en: "...No one likes to be down with a cold."
dialogues.text: "...No one likes to be down with a cold."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあな。でも、休めば良かったじゃん。今日
　から、休みって言えば休みだぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Pretty much. But you should be resting anyway, especially
now when you have no reason not to."
dialogues.text:
"Pretty much. But you should be resting anyway, especially
now when you have no reason not to."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なあ、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Right, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Right, Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
と、後ろを向く。ことりと俺が並び、音夢が背
中に付くという形になっていたのだ。
dialogues.en: I turned my head the other side to Nemu.
dialogues.text: I turned my head the other side to Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
地面をぼんやりと見つめていた音夢が、顔をあ
げた。
dialogues.en:
She was staring absent-mindedly at the ground, until her
head raised at my calling of her name.
dialogues.text:
She was staring absent-mindedly at the ground, until her
head raised at my calling of her name.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？　ああ、うん、そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah, yes, that's right."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah, yes, that's right."

dialogues.jp:
微妙に会話が止まる。俺に続いて、ことりも背
中に目を向けた。
dialogues.en:
And with that, the conversation ended. Kotori looked at me,
as if expecting me to say something.
dialogues.text:
And with that, the conversation ended. Kotori looked at me,
as if expecting me to say something.

dialogues.jp:
会話のバトンは、今は自分に来ている──そう
察したらしい音夢が、おずおず口を開いた。
dialogues.en:
Looks like the baton has been passed to me-- or so I
thought, until Nemu slowly opened her mouth again.
dialogues.text:
Looks like the baton has been passed to me-- or so I
thought, until Nemu slowly opened her mouth again.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……えと、白河さんは、何か参加されるんで
　すか？」
dialogues.en:
"...Uhhm, Shirakawa-san, what will you be doing for the
graduation party?"
dialogues.text:
"...Uhhm, Shirakawa-san, what will you be doing for the
graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Uh?"
dialogues.text: "Uh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことり、でいいですよ。その代わり、私も音
　夢って呼んでいいですよね？」
dialogues.en:
"Just call me Kotori. And likewise, may I just call you
"Nemu" as well?"
dialogues.text:
"Just call me Kotori. And likewise, may I just call you
"Nemu" as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、う、うん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, uh, okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah, uh, okay."

dialogues.jp: ぎこちなくうなずく。
dialogues.en: A rather awkward response.
dialogues.text: A rather awkward response.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私はですね、友達と一緒に、曲の生演奏をす
　るつもりなんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd be performing a song with some of my friends."
dialogues.text: "I'd be performing a song with some of my friends."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「生演奏……」
dialogues.en: "A performance..."
dialogues.text: "A performance..."

dialogues.jp: ほへ〜……と、音夢が呟く。
dialogues.en: Wooow... I could hear Nemu mutter.
dialogues.text: Wooow... I could hear Nemu mutter.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「イタリアの曲なんですけどね。私も入れて３
　人で、私がボーカルを取って……」
dialogues.en:
"It's an Italian song. I'm part of a group of 3 performing
it, with myself as the vocals..."
dialogues.text:
"It's an Italian song. I'm part of a group of 3 performing
it, with myself as the vocals..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「後のふたりが、アコースティックベースと、
　ピアノを担当するんです。ふたりとも上手な
　んですよ」
dialogues.en:
"The other two, one is on acoustic bass, and the other plays
the piano. They're really good!"
dialogues.text:
"The other two, one is on acoustic bass, and the other plays
the piano. They're really good!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Wooow..."
dialogues.text: "Wooow..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……声に出してるぞ」
dialogues.en: "...That one was audible."
dialogues.text: "...That one was audible."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はっ」

目の覚めたような顔で、口元に手をやる。そし
て何故か、俺の顔を｛にら／睨｝んだ。
dialogues.en:
As if just awakening herself to that fact, she covered her
mouth with her hand, then for some reason glared at me.
dialogues.text:
As if just awakening herself to that fact, she covered her
mouth with her hand, then for some reason glared at me.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、イタリアの曲って事は、イタリア語で
　歌うんだ？」
dialogues.en: "But wouldn't an Italian song have Italian lyrics?"
dialogues.text: "But wouldn't an Italian song have Italian lyrics?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「意味はさっぱりですけどね。まあ、念仏と一
　緒です」
dialogues.en: "The meaning is clear though. It's like a prayer chant."
dialogues.text: "The meaning is clear though. It's like a prayer chant."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「音夢は、何かやるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "But enough about me. What would you be doing, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "But enough about me. What would you be doing, Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
早速のフランクな呼びかけ。こうやって友達を
増やしているのかもしれないな、ふと、そう思っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Immediately frank and up to the point. She certainly treats
Nemu differently than she treats me.
dialogues.text:
Immediately frank and up to the point. She certainly treats
Nemu differently than she treats me.

dialogues.jp: （俺は朝倉君だけど）
dialogues.en: "(I'm still just Asakura-kun after all.)"
dialogues.text: "(I'm still just Asakura-kun after all.)"

dialogues.jp: それが、男子と女子の違いかもしれん。
dialogues.en: But that's the difference between males and females.
dialogues.text: But that's the difference between males and females.

dialogues.jp:
対する音夢は、少し硬いけれど、笑みを浮かべ
て言った。
dialogues.en:
Nemu on the other hand, looking a bit more at ease, returned
an easy smile.
dialogues.text:
Nemu on the other hand, looking a bit more at ease, returned
an easy smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私は、風紀委員なんで、特に参加はしないん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"I'm part of the disciplinary committee already, so I'm not
participating in anything in particular."
dialogues.text:
"I'm part of the disciplinary committee already, so I'm not
participating in anything in particular."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、じゃあ、裏方さんなんですね。よろし
　くお願いしますです」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, so you'd be like an usher. Let's do our jobs well!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, so you'd be like an usher. Let's do our jobs well!"

dialogues.jp: ぺこりと頭を下げ、音夢も慌てて応じた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori bowed towards Nemu, and Nemu hastily and confusedly
managed a bow back.
dialogues.text:
Kotori bowed towards Nemu, and Nemu hastily and confusedly
managed a bow back.

dialogues.jp: （通学路の真ん中で、何をやっているのやら）
dialogues.en:
"(What are they doing right in the middle of the path to
school...)"
dialogues.text:
"(What are they doing right in the middle of the path to
school...)"

dialogues.jp: ちょっとおかしい。けれど、楽しい。
dialogues.en: It's a little weird, yet somehow enjoyable.
dialogues.text: It's a little weird, yet somehow enjoyable.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今日登校してるって事は、朝倉君も何か参加
　するんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"What about you Asakura-kun? What are you participating in
to come to school today?"
dialogues.text:
"What about you Asakura-kun? What are you participating in
to come to school today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやあ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, about that..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, about that..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんたら忘れてたんですよ。準備期間だっ
　て事」
dialogues.en:
"Brother was just stupid and forgot that today was
graduation party preparations."
dialogues.text:
"Brother was just stupid and forgot that today was
graduation party preparations."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.jp:
｛きき／嬉々｝として報告する音夢に、ことりが嬉々とし
て応じる。何だかなあ……。
dialogues.en:
The two of them immediately started giggling as if they've
been friends forever. What's up with that...
dialogues.text:
The two of them immediately started giggling as if they've
been friends forever. What's up with that...

dialogues.jp:
微妙に笑いそうになってしまう口元を引き締め、
俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
As their mouths were getting ready to burst into laughter, I
said.
dialogues.text:
As their mouths were getting ready to burst into laughter, I
said.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、何となくな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's okay anyway."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's okay anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もし暇なら、音楽室まで遊びに来て下さいね」
dialogues.en:
"If you have nothing to do, why not drop by the music room
and watch us practice?"
dialogues.text:
"If you have nothing to do, why not drop by the music room
and watch us practice?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私達は、午前中、部屋を借りられる事になっ
　てますから」
dialogues.en: "We'd be borrowing the music room from noon onwards."
dialogues.text: "We'd be borrowing the music room from noon onwards."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、気が向いたら」
dialogues.en: 'Well, I'd keep that in mind."
dialogues.text: 'Well, I'd keep that in mind."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「行けばいいじゃないですか。せっかくなんだ
　から」
dialogues.en: "You should go, you seem to want to."
dialogues.text: "You should go, you seem to want to."

dialogues.jp:
そんな事を言って、笑顔を向けてくる。しかし、
目は笑っていない。全く、素直じゃない奴……。
dialogues.en:
As she said that, her face expressed a smile, but her eyes
didn't. Really, what a snide person...
dialogues.text:
As she said that, her face expressed a smile, but her eyes
didn't. Really, what a snide person...

dialogues.jp: 「だから、気が向いたらな」
dialogues.en: "That's why I said, I'd keep it in mind."
dialogues.text: "That's why I said, I'd keep it in mind."

dialogues.jp: 微妙ににらみ合う。
dialogues.en: We glared at each other for a bit.
dialogues.text: We glared at each other for a bit.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達の様子を、ことりは苦笑しつつ眺め
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori watched us from her safe vantage point, giggling
lightly.
dialogues.text:
Kotori watched us from her safe vantage point, giggling
lightly.

dialogues.jp: ◆マスク姿◆
dialogues.en: ◆Masked Figure◆
dialogues.text: ◆Masked Figure◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢と一緒に学園へと向かう。と、背後からこ
とりの呼びかける声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and I were walking towards school together. Suddenly,
Kotori voice called out to me from behind.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and I were walking towards school together. Suddenly,
Kotori voice called out to me from behind.

dialogues.jp: 風邪を引いてしまったのか、マスクをしていた。
dialogues.en: Her cold had gotten worse, so she had to wear a mask.
dialogues.text: Her cold had gotten worse, so she had to wear a mask.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは音楽室で卒業パーティーの練習をする
つもりらしく、良かったら見に来てくれと言っ
てくれた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori told me that her group had borrowed the music room
for the afternoon, and invited me to take a look.
dialogues.text:
Kotori told me that her group had borrowed the music room
for the afternoon, and invited me to take a look.

dialogues.jp: まあ、気が向いたら行くことにしよう。
dialogues.en: Well, I'd keep that in mind when it comes.
dialogues.text: Well, I'd keep that in mind when it comes.
